plants.name: Lavandula angustifolia
plants.description: Rolling Provençal hillsides ripple with violet-blue spikes, and the warm air hums with bees and smells of sweet, herbal perfume. By early August the earliest fields are fading, but many high-altitude and later-blooming plantings are still in color.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mid-June to late August, peaking in July
plants.location: Provence and the French Alps, France
plants.funFact: The name comes from the Latin 'lavare', meaning 'to wash'. Romans scented their baths with lavender.

plants.name: Helianthus annuus
plants.description: Tall, sturdy stems carry huge golden-rayed flower heads that face the sun across summer fields and gardens. Each head is made of hundreds of tiny florets, packed around a dark center.
plants.bloomingSeason: July through August, and into early autumn in many cultivars
plants.location: Temperate North America and Europe, in fields and gardens
plants.funFact: Young sunflower buds track the sun from east to west during the day. Mature flowers stop moving and mostly face east.

plants.name: Protea cynaroides
plants.description: South Africa's national flower is a dramatic bloom, with a bowl of silky pink bracts around a crown of pale, fuzzy florets. Heads can reach 30 cm across, and they bloom in the cool southern winter.
plants.bloomingSeason: July to October, in the southern hemisphere winter and spring
plants.location: Fynbos of the Western and Eastern Cape, South Africa
plants.funFact: Proteas are an ancient plant family. The genus is named after the Greek sea god Proteus, who could change his shape, because the plants vary so much in form.

plants.name: Nelumbo nucifera
plants.description: Pink-tipped petals rise on tall stems above round, water-repellent leaves on warm ponds and lakes. Each bloom opens in the morning and closes again in the evening.
plants.location: Ponds and lakes across China and East Asia
plants.funFact: Lotus leaves have a microscopic surface structure that sheds water and dirt. This 'lotus effect' has inspired self-cleaning paints and fabrics.
